candidates.description: Onam the harvest festival of kerala.We celebrate the visit of Mahabali, the wise,judicious, generous king who ruled kerala long long ago..The legend has it that those were the happiest of all times.No discrimination on the basis of caste or creed. Rich and poor were equally treated. There was neither crime, nor corruption. People did not even lock their doors, as robbery was never heard of.No sorrows nor diseases.But this happiness did not last long :-( en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahabali

candidates.description: Brown Falcon ≠===================≠ The other day we found this pair dancing across the sky in a bonding session. Sadly they were a long, long way out in the paddock and the best views of the day, I've published on the blog. Weather was a little kinder today, but still very windy. They were up again for about 10 minutes, and did make one lower, closer pass. As I wrote on the blog, they seem to have an endless routine, and both birds call raucously enjoying the moment.
